profile.headline: Software Developer II at Almac Group
profile.summary: Experienced Software Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the pharmaceuticals industry. Skilled in .Net, Web Design, Databases, and Business Management. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor focused in Information Science and Technology from Penn State University.
